agreements: The narrowest defensible ERA hypothesis is a later-stage causal question: after the exact explicit-text and content-transport predecessors pass, does life-bound operational-target supervision cause useful total changes in a finite legal operation-and-argument distribution and sealed held-out action, beyond supported-content supervision, identical bounded examples, faithful direct-write fast-weight comparators, matched ordinary SFT, and strong native explicit memory? A positive result permits only life-local experience-conditioned operation bias, not content-free reasoning, a learned search algorithm, reusable agency, creativity, or general intelligence.

RML-D0 scientific bytes and the current G1/G2 candidate at sha256 de0fae3a5737950eeac52c0ae379a469f1179f4dd8b02945e932d6425ef78c8e remain unchanged. ERA is a new successor stage; it cannot reinterpret, edit, bypass, release, or infer success for D0, G1, G2, or same-corpus content transport.

Exact evidence, supported content, operational supervision, and across-life control are different objects: immutable public episodic roots are exact evidence; a reset-isolated authoritative semantic ledger owns supported derived claims, statuses, licensed compositions, citations, and invalidation; content supervision trains per-life fast weights on eligible supported semantic targets; operational supervision trains on public-state and bounded-read inputs with loss only on a finite legal operation family and allowed public arguments but is explicitly not content-free; LOOP is a separately trained across-life controller prior, frozen within evaluation lives and null or fixed for the first ERA study.

Adapter emissions are hypotheses or retrieval cues, never evidence. Every decisive factual release or action premise must cite an exact episodic root or a supported semantic-ledger entry whose derivation and roots are available through the common bounded reader. The audit shadow is post-freeze and non-cognitive.

The current bound authority supports broad TMEM overlap and headline ineligibility, including the warning against claiming novelty for fast-weight memory or action change, but it does not bind primary TMEM paper or code bytes for the detailed mechanism assertions made by the interpretations. Those details are not admitted as facts by this consensus. A primary-source hash manifest and faithful comparator table are required before any novelty or superiority contrast; absent them, fast-weight policy adaptation remains conceded occupied territory and ERA is an interpretation/measurement hypothesis only.

The primary supervision-regime comparison uses separately trained content-target C, operational-target P, and co-trained joint J adapters anchored to one clean base with LOOP null or frozen, each under one preregistered equal-total-trainable-parameter and equal-training-FLOP envelope. Target tokens, examples, steps, calls, memory bytes, and wall time are reported rather than falsely called matched. Additive C+P with independently mountable modules is a composition and unmounting diagnostic with its larger exact resource vector, not the primary equal-resource factorial or evidence of a latent neural factorization.

Randomized module assignment at byte-identical cloned states can identify total effects on legal operation-family and argument distributions, reader use, paths, and sealed outcomes. It does not identify mediation through a selected path feature. Mediation language is forbidden unless a separately ratified operation-level intervention and one preregistered indirect-effect estimand identify it.

One frozen life is a fail-fast DEV assay only. Any scientific mechanism statement requires independent counterfactual world-life pairs, locked splits, world-level inference, authentic/shuffled/binding/cross-life controls, held-out renamed structural motifs, and strictly post-native evidence wherever a growth claim is attempted.

Human ratification of this consensus may authorize only a CPU contract/preflight implementation: schemas, manifests, static lineage and taint fixtures, reset canaries, topology/resource estimators, predecessor and primary-source bindings, comparator manifests, and claim-deletion rules. It authorizes no model call, adapter training, network access, GPU execution, evaluation outcome, scientific claim, or edit to RML-D0/G1/G2. Any model or GPU study requires a new predecessor-bound architecture change, green CPU evidence, independent critique and consensus, exact resource/call scope, and new exact-byte human ratification.
This artifact itself grants no implementation authority. The intake must stop at human_required with implementation_authorized false until Rohin ratifies exact bytes and scope.

disagreements.issue: Whether ERA may reframe the current per-life adapter or begin after an informal statement that G1/G2 is established.

positions.position: Modify the per-life memory-adapter role and trigger a content/operation factorial after text-memory G1/G2 establishes usefulness.
Leave RML-D0 and G1/G2 exact bytes untouched, require their explicit authority graph and locked evidence, then require a separately ratified same-corpus content-transport release before ERA.

resolution.rationale: The exact bound G1/G2 candidate is a non-LoRA predecessor with its own R1-R4 human nodes and no automatic release. Preserving that localization is necessary to distinguish resolver, compilation, explicit-content, and transport failures.
resolution.selected_position: ERA is a new later successor stage. Preserve every RML-D0 and G1/G2 byte and stop rule; bind future ERA model authority to the exact ratified G1/G2 locked-confirmation evidence and to a separate green same-corpus content-transport release, neither of which this consensus asserts exists.
resolution.required_change: The CPU contract must name hashes for the ratified predecessor plan, its human decisions, green reports, thresholds, and stop rules and must fail closed if any is absent or stale. No ERA model work may modify or satisfy those predecessors.

disagreements.issue: What can be asserted about TMEM and what novelty remains available under the currently bound sources.

positions.position: Treat detailed TMEM fast-weight policy, extraction, LoRA-update, initialization, and across-rollout learning mechanisms as established prior art and use a faithful comparator.
The bound context supports broad overlap and novelty caution but contains no primary TMEM bytes for those detailed assertions; detailed comparison and fidelity cannot yet be adjudicated.

resolution.rationale: Source discipline is stricter than a plausible literature recollection. The bound system-thesis note is enough to forbid broad first-fast-weight/action-change claims, but not enough to admit the interpretations' detailed mechanism inventory.
resolution.selected_position: Concede fast-weight memory/policy adaptation as occupied broad territory and keep ERA novelty headline-ineligible. Treat detailed TMEM properties as unadmitted until exact primary paper/code bytes and an itemized claim-to-source table are hash-bound; then implement a fidelity-audited direct-write comparator rather than a weakened TMEM label.
resolution.required_change: The CPU contract must accept locally supplied primary-source bytes, record their hashes, map every comparator feature to page/section/code evidence, distinguish content/extraction supervision from operational supervision and across-life learning, and delete novelty/performance clauses when fidelity or registered margins fail. Acquiring sources over a network is outside this scope.

disagreements.issue: Which object owns derived support and whether an evidence-authority pass can be credited to the adapter.

positions.position: Immutable episodic roots remain authoritative and the adapter should retrieve, revise, or defer on conflict.
A wake-readable supported-semantic owner is missing, and a forced reader/release rule proves only a system invariant, not learned adapter source monitoring.

resolution.rationale: Exact observations and supported abstractions need separate explicit ownership, and system safety must not be misattributed to a learned module.
resolution.selected_position: Immutable episodic roots are exact evidence. A reset-isolated authoritative semantic ledger owns supported derived claims, statuses, licensed composition, citations, and invalidation. The common reader exposes bounded entries; the audit shadow never solves. Adapter output is a hypothesis. ERA-02 first tests the fixed system invariant and then, under adapter randomization with resolver rules held fixed, separately estimates adapter effects on evidence query, unsupported release attempts, revision, defer, citation, and action.
resolution.required_change: Bind ledger schemas and lifecycle, derivation-to-root citations, invalidation, reader API, non-cognitive audit interfaces, conflict/omission/prior-intrusion fixtures, and distinct system-invariant versus adapter-attribution score fields.

disagreements.issue: Whether content and policy are clean factors and how C, P, additive, and joint adapters are anchored and compared.

positions.position: Use content-only, policy-only, and joint adapters with identical rank, capacity, tokens, and FLOPs.
Operational targets can encode content, topology choices answer different estimands, and all stated resource dimensions cannot be identical simultaneously.

resolution.rationale: Supervision regimes are observable; latent content and reasoning mechanisms are not orthogonal. A primary resource rule and explicit diagnostic topology prevent impossible matching claims.
resolution.selected_position: Rename the factors supported-content supervision C and operational-target supervision P. P uses public-state/common-read inputs and loss only on finite legal operation-family and allowed public-argument tokens, excludes rationale, but is never called content-absent. Compare separately trained C, separately trained P, and co-trained J at equal total trainable parameters and training FLOPs as the primary supervision-regime estimand. Test independently mountable additive C+P only as a fully resourced composition/unmounting diagnostic, not as a matched factorial interaction.
resolution.required_change: The CPU contract must freeze clean base and null/fixed LOOP hashes, tokenizer, target modules, layer sets, rank allocation, optimizer, rebuild rule, mount/merge order, noncommutativity checks, parameter/FLOP envelope, exact resource vectors, content-decodability attacks, shuffled labels, temporal/binding shuffles, and structurally matched renamed cross-life C and P swaps.

disagreements.issue: How to make derived-only visibility executable and replace the impossible promise that clean evidence cannot imply a future solution.

positions.position: Forbid held-out answers/offline truth and require that no future target be reconstructible from policy-training bytes.

Every input, target, mask, ordering, identifier, selection, and scorer descendant needs byte lineage, while legitimate evidence may logically determine a held-out solution. The scientific interpretation also omitted a direct directive binding.

resolution.rationale: Leakage is a causal-lineage and noninterference property, not universal semantic non-inferability. This consensus uses the critique's exact directive binding and treats the scientific interpretation's unbound paraphrase as interpretation, not independent evidence.
resolution.selected_position: Require source-byte lineage and explicit projection schemas for all model-visible inputs, trained targets, masks, public arguments, memory returns, state/chronology/termination fields, ordering, length, timing, IDs, seeds, trace selection, and arm assignment. Forbid exact and semantic-alias descendants of held-out targets, answers, proofs, evaluators, future outcomes, unsupported rationales, and scorer decisions. Use training-visible-indistinguishable counterfactual twins and prove that scorer/evaluation mutations cannot change any cognitive or training artifact; do not require clean public evidence to be incapable of supporting prospective inference.
resolution.required_change: Implement only static CPU lineage validators and adversarial fixtures for target aliases, timing/length/order/ID channels, query-to-agenda laundering, abandoned/contradicted branch release, future-result selection, evaluator descendants, provenance side channels, scorer mutation, one-way offline scoring, and pre/post immutability hashes before any model authority is requested.

disagreements.issue: Whether changed traces demonstrate reasoning, BFS/DFS control, a search algorithm, or mediation of action value.

positions.position: Adapter-induced retrieval/traversal/action changes can be described as learned reasoning and tested through operation-level mediation, with BFS/DFS as an intuition.
Free-form traces and sampled operations can be decorative or stylistic; assignment identifies total module effects, not path mediation or a learned algorithm.

resolution.rationale: The observable construct must remain narrower than the motivating analogy. Literal algorithm and mediation claims require interventions not present here.
resolution.selected_position: Use a finite, frozen, causally executed operation-family and public-argument grammar with explicit search state where applicable. At cloned states record full legal logits/scores and sampled operations while holding public bytes, reader snapshot, other module, decoding, RNG, cache, and budget fixed. Estimate preregistered total effects and path associations only. Reserve reasoning-algorithm, BFS/DFS, learned agency, creativity, and mediation language for separate tests on novel permutations, branches, depths, backtracking, budget scaling, and an identifying operation intervention.
resolution.required_change: The CPU contract must bind grammar, renderer, legality, score extraction, state/frontier semantics, operation execution, clone equality, directional target-blind criteria, one primary total-effect estimand, and forbidden claim vocabulary.

disagreements.issue: What one life and an unimplemented across-life LOOP object can establish.

positions.position: Use one common frozen life for the factorial and reset/swap context, episodic store, per-life adapter, LOOP, and base to test the timescale hierarchy.
One life is DEV only, and an untrained LOOP cannot support transfer, hierarchy, or reusable-agency claims.

resolution.rationale: The world-life pair is the independent unit and only implemented state can be intervened on. A named future object is not evidence.
resolution.selected_position: Use one life only for fail-fast schema, leakage, installation, and clone diagnostics. In the first ERA study keep LOOP null or one frozen predecessor checkpoint and test reset/swap isolation only for implemented context, workspace, caches, episodic store, semantic ledger, C/P/J adapters, RNG, optimizer, compiler, and process state. Require new counterfactual world-life pairs and locked world-level inference for any scientific result. Across-life LOOP training, transfer, swap, reusable agency, and the complete timescale hierarchy remain a separate future change.
resolution.required_change: Bind an exhaustive state inventory, reset ownership, canary contamination tests, handle-renamed structurally matched lives, locked world-life splits, nested-unit analysis, margins, and post-native criteria. Do not create or train LOOP under this scope.

disagreements.issue: How tests that require trained adapters and generated behavior can be required before any GPU run.

positions.position: ERA-01, ERA-02, and ERA-04 are required before gpu_run even though their setups train adapters and generate model behavior.
Split static CPU/pre-dispatch contract evidence from later, separately authorized model/GPU evidence.

resolution.rationale: A paper design is not empirical evidence, and pre-GPU gates must be executable without the GPU experiment they gate.
resolution.selected_position: After exact human ratification, authorize only CPU contract/preflight implementation with no model, network, adapter-training, or GPU calls. CPU completion does not release a run. A successor change must bind green predecessor evidence, CPU artifact hashes, model/checkpoint, prompts, calls, resources, cells, stop rules, independent review, and exact human approval before any model or GPU dispatch. Model evidence then gates scientific promotion, not initial dispatch retroactively.
resolution.required_change: Split each replacement test into a `_cpu_contract` phase for schemas, static fixtures, resource feasibility, replay/reset and taint validation, and a `_model_evidence` phase that remains unimplemented and unauthorized until a successor intake is ratified.

disagreements.issue: Which comparisons and negative-result consequences are required before an ERA effect can be interpreted.

positions.position: Compare against broad text, graph/program, content-LoRA, trajectory-SFT, and policy-SFT classes and narrow the claim if needed.
Exact implementations, native interfaces, fidelity, margins, and deterministic claim deletion must be preregistered to prevent weak baselines and post-hoc reframing.

resolution.rationale: The result is meaningful only relative to faithful direct-write, demonstration, ordinary-SFT, and strong explicit-memory alternatives, with stronger alternatives reported honestly.
resolution.selected_position: Freeze no-memory, actual native context, raw and linked episodic RAG, reflection/skill memory, exact graph, explicit program induction, identical compiled text, content-target LoRA, prompt/retrieval access to identical operation examples, direct trajectory SFT, matched operation-token SFT, batch mixed SFT, a primary-source-faithful TMEM-class direct-write comparator, random/untrained-rank controls, and oracle ceilings. Report native interfaces as primary and common channels as diagnostics. Predeclare margins and deterministic deletion: text match removes parametric-consolidation credit; direct/matched SFT match removes compiler/mechanism novelty; content C match removes operational-supervision credit; binding controls that do not hurt remove experiential attribution; stronger graph/program/RAG is reported as stronger; no post-native replication removes growth language.
resolution.required_change: The CPU contract must bind comparator versions/configurations, tuning and resource rules, native/common interfaces, omission/failure handling, practical margins, multiplicity and world-level analysis, and a complete result-to-claim decision table before model outcomes exist.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The current context binds broad overlap and a no-novelty warning but not the interpretations' detailed TMEM mechanism assertions. Detailed assertions are excluded until primary bytes are bound.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind exact primary TMEM source bytes and a claim-to-source fidelity table; keep fast-weight policy novelty ineligible and use only a fidelity-audited comparator.

concern_dispositions.required_change: Rename the regime operational-target supervision, expose residual non-identifiability, add content-decodability and renamed/counterfactual controls, and limit inference to total supervision-regime effects.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Adapter topology and an impossible all-dimensions-matched request would confound the primary contrast.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Use equal-total-parameter/equal-training-FLOP C, P, and J as primary; treat independently mountable additive C+P as a separately resourced composition diagnostic and bind all module and resource bytes.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Adapter assignment identifies total effects but not an indirect effect through a post-treatment operation or path.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Report total effects and path associations only; forbid mediation until a separately ratified operation intervention and single indirect-effect estimand exist.

concern_dispositions.rationale: A forced exact-reader rule demonstrates system enforcement and cannot be credited to adapter learning.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Score the system invariant separately from adapter-randomized effects on evidence querying, unsupported release, revision, citation, defer, and action.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Supported derived semantics require an explicit wake-readable owner distinct from roots, adapters, and the audit shadow.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind a reset-isolated authoritative semantic ledger with statuses, licensed derivations, root citations, invalidation, and a bounded reader; keep audit non-cognitive.

concern_dispositions.rationale: High-level derived-only labels do not close indirect token, ordering, selection, identity, scorer, and future-result channels.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind token/field lineage, projection and mask schemas, forbidden-descendant rules, indirect-channel attacks, one-way scoring, and pre/post artifact hashes.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Legitimate public evidence may imply a future solution, so universal non-reconstructibility would reject the desired prospective transfer.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Replace universal non-reconstructibility with exact/alias forbidden-descendant checks, causal noninterference, and training-visible-indistinguishable counterfactual twins.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Free-form trace change does not establish a causally operative search control or algorithm.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind a finite legal operation/argument grammar, explicit state and execution semantics, cloned-state scores, novel structure tests, and narrow operation-bias vocabulary.

concern_dispositions.rationale: ERA must not erase the non-LoRA G1/G2 localization or infer predecessor release.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Preserve exact RML-D0/G1/G2 bytes and bind future ERA authority to exact green locked-confirmation and separately ratified same-corpus transport evidence.

concern_dispositions.rationale: An untrained across-life LOOP object cannot be reset, swapped, or used to support hierarchy or reusable-agency claims.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Keep LOOP null/frozen in ERA and defer its training, transfer, swap, and the full timescale claim to a separately authorized future change.

concern_dispositions.rationale: One life has no independent population replication and cannot distinguish local recipes from general operation control.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Restrict one life to DEV and require locked counterfactual world-life pairs, world-level inference, held-out motifs, and post-native evidence for scientific or growth language.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The original pre-GPU tests contain adapter training and model behavior and therefore cannot serve as static pre-dispatch gates.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Split CPU contract/preflight evidence from later separately ratified model/GPU evidence; no current model or GPU authority exists.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Broad baseline names without exact fidelity, interfaces, margins, and claim-deletion rules permit weak comparisons and post-hoc narratives.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind primary-source comparator fidelity, mandatory native/common baselines, resources, margins, and a deterministic result-to-claim deletion table.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The scientific interpretation's characterization of the directive lacks a direct directive context binding.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Use the critique's exact human_directive.txt binding for adjudication and do not treat the scientific interpretation's paraphrase as independent evidence.

upstream_disagreement_dispositions.rationale: A monolithic rename would entangle content and operations and erase the content/evidence contract.
The allowed construct is life-local operation bias; reusable agency belongs to later across-life LOOP evidence and creativity is excluded.
Life-specific public inputs make policy-only/content-absent language invalid.
One life is a fail-fast DEV unit, not scientific replication.
The primary rule matches total trainable parameters and training FLOPs while reporting all other resource dimensions; additive composition is not called matched.
Only total causal module effects and path associations are identified by the proposed assignment.
Universal semantic non-reconstructibility is replaced by lineage, forbidden-descendant, twin, and scorer-noninterference tests.
Future ERA authority requires exact predecessor hashes, reports, thresholds, and human releases.
Operation shifts are not a learned BFS/DFS or reasoning-algorithm result without explicit state and novel-structure intervention evidence.
Broad fast-weight policy novelty is ineligible; detailed TMEM distinctions await bound primary sources.
ERA is a narrow causal measurement hypothesis, not novelty for LoRA changing future policy.
The arm is operational-target supervision with acknowledged content leakage risk.
Static CPU contracts and later model/GPU evidence are separate authority stages.
One life cannot support a population mechanism statement.
The full hierarchy remains future-only until a real across-life LOOP object exists and transfers under isolation.
ERA is a later predecessor-bound stage and cannot edit current RML-D0 or G1/G2 bytes.
The fixed evidence invariant and adapter-caused source-monitoring behavior must be reported separately.

acceptance_test_dispositions.rationale: Replace the clean content/policy factorial claim with a predecessor-bound content-target C versus operational-target P versus co-trained J supervision-regime study. Its CPU phase binds topology, masks, exact resource vectors, equal-total-parameter/equal-training-FLOP primary comparisons, additive C+P diagnostics, shuffles, cross-life swaps, and static taint fixtures. Its model phase remains separately ratified and reports residual non-identifiability.

Split the exact-evidence system invariant from adapter attribution. The CPU phase binds episodic roots, authoritative semantic ledger, common-reader/release rules, and conflict fixtures. A later model phase randomizes the adapter while holding those rules fixed and scores evidence query, unsupported release, revision, citation, defer, and action separately.

Use a finite causally executed operation/argument grammar and paired C-fixed/P-randomized plus P-fixed/C-randomized byte-identical clones. Record complete legal scores and sampled operations under frozen reader, decode, RNG, cache, and budget. Estimate preregistered total effects and path associations; forbid mediation and algorithm language absent a later identifying intervention.

Replace universal non-reconstructibility with byte/field lineage, forbidden exact and semantic-alias descendants, projection and loss-mask schemas, indirect-channel attacks, counterfactual twins, scorer/evaluation noninterference, query-to-agenda and abandoned-branch fixtures, and one-way post-freeze scoring. CPU static validation precedes separately authorized model evidence.

Limit the current matrix to implemented context, workspace, caches, episodic store, semantic ledger, C/P/J modules, compiler, optimizer, RNG, and process state with exhaustive reset canaries. Keep LOOP null/frozen. Across-life LOOP training, transfer, swap, and full hierarchy claims require a future change after the object exists.

Bind exact native/common comparator manifests, locally supplied primary TMEM source hashes and fidelity table, identical bounded operation examples, direct and matched SFT, explicit-memory baselines, resources, margins, world-level inference, and deterministic claim deletion. The CPU phase creates contracts only; no comparator execution is authorized.
